prompt:
A Binary Search Tree (BST) is constructed by sequentially inserting the following keys into an initially empty tree:
`[105, 55, 155, 30, 80, 130, 180]`

What is the exact **Postorder** traversal sequence of this tree?
explanation: Postorder traversal visits Left Subtree -> Right Subtree -> Root. Root 105 is processed last after all its children: [30, 80, 55, 130, 180, 155, 105].
